character.name: Idle
character.prompt: Create a 2D pixel-art character for a humorous retro side-scrolling action platformer set in Santiago, Chile.  Character: A tired office-worker zombie commuting during rush hour. An adult human with a slightly hunched posture, pale gray-green skin, heavy dark circles under the eyes, messy dark hair and a vacant, exhausted expression.  Clothing: A wrinkled light-blue office shirt, loosened dark-red tie, charcoal trousers and worn black shoes. Carry a small brown briefcase in one hand, held low beside the body. The briefcase will later be used for a short melee attack.  Personality: Comically exhausted and mildly grumpy, like someone who missed the bus after a long workday. Funny and recognizable rather than terrifying. No gore.  Pose and style: - Single neutral standing pose, ready to be animated later. - Strict side-scrolling camera, not top-down or isometric. - For the right-facing view, show a clear side profile facing right. - Compact, slightly cartoonish proportions with a readable head and briefcase. - 48x48 pixel canvas. - Crisp pixel edges, limited palette, simple shading and a clean dark outline. - Keep the entire character and briefcase inside the canvas. - Transparent background. - No text, scenery, logos, extra characters or animation frames. - No firearms, armor or additional accessories.  The character should fit a playful pixel-art game where an urban pigeon fights by spitting Chilean hot dogs.
